candidates.original_title: Culture's Consequences: International Differences in Work-Related Values
candidates.description: National differences in Individualism-Collectivism are reflected in country-level work values and cultural attitudes.
candidates.citation_sentence: Turning to the literature in cross-cultural psychology for guidance in this study, the seminal work of Geert Hofstede (1980, 1991) seemed the most relevant.
candidates.notes: One of four distinct Hofstede dimensions tested using the same pilot sample. The authors report a successful conceptual replication for Individualism-Collectivism, although the more stringent direct replication using Hofstede's prescribed items and formulae was weaker.
